+ Last Updated: November 1, 2026 +

+

+ At booktodotask, your privacy and data autonomy are our topmost priorities. We operate under a strict Zero Third-Party Data Storage model. +

+ +

1. Data Storage & Ownership

+

+ All your wall tasks, notes, journal entries, and drawings stay strictly on your local device (via browser localStorage). When you link your Google account, your data syncs directly with your own Google Drive inside an isolated, hidden application folder (appDataFolder). +

+ +

2. Google Drive Permissions

+

+ We only request the drive.appdata scope. We cannot view, access, edit, or delete any of your personal files, photos, or documents stored on your Google Drive. Only the JSON state created by this app is read and updated. +

+ +

3. No Tracking or Analytics

+

+ We do not sell, track, or share any personal telemetry or session logs with advertisers or data brokers. +

+ +

4. Data Deletion

+

+ You can disconnect your Google Drive at any time via the Disconnect button, or clear your local browser storage to erase all workspace data permanently. +
